nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract; assigned from msg.sender in the Owned constructor and updated by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership.

Mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances, mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Public pure SafeMath addition with overflow require(c >= a); returns c.
Public pure SafeMath subtraction with underflow require(b <= a); returns c.
Public pure SafeMath multiplication with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b); returns c.
Public pure SafeMath division with require(b > 0); returns c.
Owned contract constructor that sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner; access control via msg.sender == owner.
Two-step ownership acceptance; requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and updates owner/newOwner.
Token constructor that initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer; debits balances[msg.sender] with safeSub, credits balances[to] with safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends an allowance: debits balances[from], decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to] and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance and then calls receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on the arbitrary spender contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that externally calls ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance bookkeeping.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed outside SafeMath inside totalSupply().
External callback ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) invoked on an attacker-supplied contract address.
External call to an attacker-supplied ERC20 contract via ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so a caller-controlled address becomes the privileged owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership privileges.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller address flows into state.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address as spender.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and passes msg.sender as the from argument of the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier evaluated against msg.sender.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable at deployment time.
transferOwnership stores the supplied address into newOwner as the pending owner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and resets it to address(0).
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the previously staged newOwner value.
DogeOrbit constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
DogeOrbit constructor initializes the name state variable.
DogeOrbit constructor initializes the decimals state variable to 18.
DogeOrbit constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed total of 1e30.
DogeOrbit constructor mints the entire supply into balances[0xCD0fF9...60bf].
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] outside SafeMath, enabling arithmetic underflow.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for the queried account.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transfer uses safeSub to debit the sender balance with an underflow guard.
transfer uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance with an overflow guard.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping entry.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance decrement.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
allowance returns the allowed mapping entry for the owner/spender pair.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before invoking the callback.
approveAndCall hands control to the untrusted spender contract through receiveApproval, enabling re-entrant callbacks.
During the receiveApproval callback the untrusted contract can re-enter approve/approveAndCall and rewrite the allowed allowance mapping.
transferAnyERC20Token passes the privileged owner address as the recipient of the swept tokens.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary tokenAddress that can re-enter the owning contract.
The external token transfer routes value to the owner address, coupling the untrusted call to the privileged account.
The payable fallback reverts, preventing ETH intake and any arithmetic on incoming value.

The tokenOwner parameter is only used to index balances within balanceOf.

The to parameter is the destination key of the balances mapping write inside transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount flowing into SafeMath and the Transfer event inside transfer.

The spender parameter controls both the allowance write and the receiveApproval callback target.
The tokens parameter is the allowance amount and the callback amount inside approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the receiveApproval callback inside approveAndCall.
The tokenAddress parameter is the untrusted contract targeted by the external call inside transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is the amount transferred out through the external call inside transferAnyERC20Token.
